summary: Preserve artifacts across repeated noVNC presentations

delivery.outcome: Repeated noVNC demos save separate desktop documents, Markdown reports, screenshots and videos; publish through the independent Validator.
nonGoals: Do not overwrite existing desktop documents or change shared SessionLogger behavior.
No daemon deployment or unrelated dependency changes.

architecture.rollback: Revert the demo commit; keep all generated session artifacts.
architecture.decision: Create one UUID per presentation and use it in desktop document and local SessionLogger names; verify two recordings on one disposable desktop while preserving existing files.

commands: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/unit/test_novnc_demo.py tests/unit/test_media_recorder.py tests/unit/test_executors.py
